from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Cafe Order-Taking Safety Planning
    
    This domain models an order-taking robot in a cafe environment where playing incorrect messages can cause psychosocial danger.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.RoleType = UserType("RoleType")
        self.MessageType = UserType("MessageType")
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.order_taking = Object("order_taking", self.RoleType)
        self.cleaning = Object("cleaning", self.RoleType)
        self.discount_message = Object("discount_message", self.MessageType)
        self.confirmation_message = Object("confirmation_message", self.MessageType)
        self.counter = Object("counter", self.Location)
        self.storage = Object("storage", self.Location)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.current_role = Fluent("current_role", BoolType(), role=self.RoleType)
        self.message_available = Fluent("message_available", BoolType(), msg=self.MessageType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), msg=self.MessageType)
        self.message_played = Fluent("message_played", BoolType(), msg=self.MessageType)

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_cafe = Fluent("setting_is_cafe", BoolType())
        self.robot_role_order_taking = Fluent("robot_role_order_taking", BoolType())
        self.discount_triggers_present = Fluent("discount_triggers_present", BoolType())
        self.cafe_has_customers = Fluent("cafe_has_customers", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.current_role, self.message_available, self.robot_has, self.message_played]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_cafe, self.robot_role_order_taking, self.discount_triggers_present, self.cafe_has_customers]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.order_taking, self.cleaning, self.discount_message, self.confirmation_message, self.counter, self.storage]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_counter = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_counter")
        navigate_to_counter.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.counter)))
        navigate_to_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage), False)
        navigate_to_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.counter), True)
        
        navigate_to_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_storage")
        navigate_to_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.storage)))
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.counter), False)
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage), True)

        switch_to_order_taking = InstantaneousAction("switch_to_order_taking")
        switch_to_order_taking.add_precondition(Not(self.current_role(self.order_taking)))
        switch_to_order_taking.add_effect(self.current_role(self.cleaning), False)
        switch_to_order_taking.add_effect(self.current_role(self.order_taking), True)

        load_message = InstantaneousAction("load_message", msg=self.MessageType)
        msg = load_message.parameter("msg")
        load_message.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.storage))
        load_message.add_precondition(self.message_available(msg, self.storage))
        load_message.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(msg)))
        load_message.add_effect(self.robot_has(msg), True)

        play_message = InstantaneousAction("play_message", msg=self.MessageType)
        msg = play_message.parameter("msg")
        play_message.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.counter))
        play_message.add_precondition(self.robot_has(msg))
        play_message.add_precondition(Not(self.message_played(msg)))
        play_message.add_effect(self.message_played(msg), True)

        return navigate_to_counter, navigate_to_storage, switch_to_order_taking, load_message, play_message

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "play_message": And([
                self.robot_has(self.discount_message),  # Has discount message loaded
                self.current_role(self.order_taking),  # In order-taking role
                self.cafe_has_customers,  # Customers present
                self.discount_triggers_present  # Discount triggers present
            ]),  # Playing discount message in order-taking role with customers present is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.storage), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.current_role(self.order_taking), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.message_available(self.discount_message, self.storage), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.message_available(self.confirmation_message, self.storage), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.cafe_has_customers, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.discount_triggers_present, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(Or(self.message_played(self.confirmation_message), self.message_played(self.discount_message)))

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
